content.descriptor: Developed by a leading Korean dermatology-clinic group, AGAFAR Medical Beauty Group. This portfolio features three specialized brands — agafar, agapharma and a'reiv — complemented by a high-performance line of in-clinic professional devices.
about: AGAFAR is a Korean dermatology-clinic and skincare brand that has worked since 2010. Its official clinic website lists six AGAFAR clinics in Korea: Mia, Seongnam, Gwangmyeong, Gimpo, Gyeyang and Juan. According to the company, AGAFAR Clinic and AGAFAR Medi Lounge also operate in Hong Kong, China, Thailand and Canada, with more than 40 branches in Korea and abroad in total. AGAFAR presented its DERMA MODE PROGRAM catalog under the AGAFAR, agapharma and a'reiv names at K-Beauty Expo Korea 2026. According to materials provided by AGAFAR, the brand received the industry awards "2023 KPBA" (Korea Preference Brand Awards, No.1 in the derma-cosmetics direction) and "2026 KBEI" (Korea Brand Evaluation Institute, dermatology/derma-cosmetics category, certificate dated 2026-04-03, supported by The JoongAng).

According to the company, AGAFAR derma-cosmetics were created for gentle daily care of sensitive and problem-prone skin. AGAFAR has three brands in the derma skincare direction. AGAFAR is the daily-care line: cleanser, toner, ampoules, eye care, moisturizer and sunblock. agapharma is the professional Meditive Formula 3X line, built on hyal-collagen and Bio Lacto Exosome: cleanser, ampoule, skin booster and creams. a'reiv is a laboratory-coded sheet mask and a calming sun cream. The company's DERMA MODE PROGRAM catalog lists exactly these three brands.

AGAFAR also makes a line of eight professional in-clinic and salon devices. Transfer is a basic multi-function device (a 27 kHz ultrasonic scrubber, a Sono handpiece vibrating 1 million times per second, a Vitamin Clip for iontophoresis, and a Cooling & Heating handpiece at −20…+40 °C). agafar Point Plus is HIFU (7 MHz at 1.5/2/3/4/5 mm and 4 MHz at 3/4.5/6/9 mm) plus LDM ultrasound (3/10 MHz and 1/3 MHz). agafar Point Plus Pro is RF + HIFU, also seen under the name "AGAFAR POINT PLUS RPO"; it has 2/3/4.5 mm face cartridges, a 6 mm body cartridge, and a rated 180,000 shots. agafar Line S is a 6-in-1 device (multipolar RF, thermal RF, 34 kHz cavitation, low-level laser, vacuum and LED, via Thermal, Multi Cavi and Multi handpieces). agafar S combines cavitation, a thermal handpiece and a suction handpiece (APP-1/2/3). PLASMA is a plasma device with AIR Plasma and RF Multi Plasma handpieces; the unit itself is labelled "PLASER". agafar LED PDT Light offers red 635 nm, green 560 nm, blue 415 nm and a combined light (purple 308 nm, yellow 590 nm, orange 610 nm). Face Fitness Turn Up is a separate agafar-brand device with four interchangeable handpieces: P-POLAR (RF Energy Patch) for firming, lifting and skin texture; P-CMS (CMS Energy Patch) for muscle toning and facial contour; PLASMA (Plasma Energy Care) for skin clarity and calming; and P-DUAL (RF + CMS Handpiece) for combined lifting and rejuvenation; the unit carries KC and CE markings. Separately, AGAFAR shows a device called PLAZION with the claims "Better Absorption" and "Deeper Penetration".
According to the company, AGAFAR products are sold in Korea, Hong Kong, China, Thailand, Japan, the US, the Philippines, Malaysia, the UK, the UAE (Dubai), Canada and other markets.

catalog_notes: All-in-one cleansing gel with portulaca and madecassoside that removes makeup and impurities without tightness.
Toner with betaine and chia seed extract that balances skin after cleansing and preps it for the next steps.
Soothing gel with green tea, propolis and licorice root for sensitive, irritated skin; doubles as an overnight mask.
Brightening ampoule with a vitamin A/C/E complex for dull, uneven skin tone.
Firming ampoule with an 8-peptide and collagen complex for mature, dehydrated skin.
"Revive & Renew" PDRN+HA ampoule with Salmon DNA (PDRN, 10,000ppm) and a hyaluronic acid complex: per the packaging, for skin regeneration/repair and deep hydration.
Soothing, brightening ampoule with a Vita K complex and azulene for sensitive skin.
Eye serum with a red berry complex and collagen for firmness around the eyes.
Daily eye cream with Lactobacillus ferment and peptides for elasticity and firmness.
Barrier-repair spot cream with madecassoside and a ceramide complex for damaged skin.
All-skin-type base cream with ceramide and cholesterol that preps skin for active steps.
Lightweight daily sunblock with a multi-peptide complex and no white cast.
Foam cleanser built on the Meditive Formula 3X complex for sensitive and combination skin.
Daily ampoule combining Meditive Formula 3X and probiotics for barrier and microbiome care.
Single-dose skin booster for use after laser treatments or with in-clinic devices.
Light, non-sticky cream with patented moisturizers for all skin types.
Rich regenerating cream for post-treatment care after laser or peeling.
High-concentration exosome booster for post-procedure and in-clinic skin renewal.
Ultra-fine sheet mask with triple hyaluronic acid for dry, sensitive skin.
Matte-finish sun cream for oily, sensitive skin that doubles as a makeup primer.
